source: Tranche 0 — fermeture transactionnelle pipeline T0+T1. error_code enum data-driven, zero hardcoding (CLAUDE.md §10, doctrine 03 §3).
consumers: apps/api/migrations/073_finalize_pipeline.sql — embeds this array verbatim in the seed DO block
apps/api/src/routes/engine.ts /finalize handler — error_code FK validation against run_error_codes table
apps/chatbot-py/app/domain/error_resolver.py — runtime cache loaded once at startup via SELECT code FROM run_error_codes
note: code is the natural key. severity ∈ {error, warning}. Labels are FR/EN/AR for i18n at the UI surface (Tranche 1+). Adding a new code = (this file + new migration) — never a switch in code.
